claim_reviews.conclusion: Meaning is related to erase/delete, but memadamkan is the safer standard form for deleting data in Malaysian Malay.

claim_reviews.conclusion: “To delete digital data” is appropriately narrowed and matches the intended sense.

claim_reviews.conclusion: Valid at the lemma level: Indonesian menghapus and Malaysian memadamkan are distinct localized forms for the same sense.

claim_reviews.subject: False-friend contrast

response.rationale: Menghapus correctly means “to delete/remove” in Indonesian. In Malaysian Malay, memadam is semantically related, but standard transitive usage for deleting digital data is better represented by memadamkan; DBP technology terminology uses memadamkan data/content. The contrast is not a false friend, though the current Malaysian form may teach a less idiomatic collocation.
